text:
Maya (AM): quick sync — onboarding StrataCo as a channel reseller. Need a tight technical handoff: SSO + SCIM, entitlement mapping, partner egress IPs, cert exchange flow, provisional reseller pricing, and a tenant provisioning test plan. cc @Alex @Samir @Jia

Alex (Solutions): I'll take SSO/SCIM and entitlement mapping. We have a template mapping groups->tiers; will adapt. Will include sample metadata XML + SCIM payloads.

Samir (SRE): partner will reach our staging & prod endpoints from their VPC. Need list of egress IPs and TLS/client cert steps. Suggest mTLS for control-plane. Sending sample firewall snippet.

Jia (Security): I'll attach SOC2 and redacted questionnaire answers. Confirming requirement: customer-managed KMS for enterprise SKUs; no PII in logs; rotation policy for client certs.

Todd (Partnerships): pricing ask: 12% reseller discount for first 3 months, then standard reseller tier. Sales needs temporary SKU and billing tag. I'll draft numbers.

Maya (AM): runbook outline: 1) entitlement mapping + SCIM groups 2) SAML setup & validation steps 3) allowlist + cert exchange 4) billing SKU + entitlements 5) provisioning smoke tests + rollback. Assign owners?

Alex (Solutions): owner for 1 and 2. Will post PR with docs and example test curl.

Samir (SRE): firewall sample for partner infra:
```
# allow outbound to Redwood endpoints
-A OUTPUT -d 18.194.23.11/32 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -d 18.194.23.12/32 -j ACCEPT
# endpoints
staging.redwood-inference.net:443
prod.redwood-inference.net:443
```
Client cert flow: partner uploads CSR via portal, we sign and return cert. Add expiration check and rotation note. Idle timeout: 45s.

Jia (Security): add to runbook:
- mTLS on control-plane endpoints
- KMS ARN requirement for CMK
- redaction policy link
- compliance contact + SOC2 URL

Todd (Partnerships): pricing draft posted to shared sheet; will attach to handoff.

infra-bot: reminder set for 2024-05-15T16:00:00Z (30m before call)

Maya (AM): owners & deadlines: Alex -> SAML/SCIM doc by EOD; Samir -> allowlist + cert steps by tomorrow AM; Jia -> questionnaire + SOC2 link; Todd -> pricing draft. Partner intro call Fri 9am PT.

Alex (Solutions): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/presales/runbooks/pull/77 includes metadata example, SCIM payloads, and test cases (provision + smoke).

Samir (SRE): staging provision example:
```
POST https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/accounts/provision
Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN_xyz
{ "partner_org": "strataco", "admin_email": "ops@strata.co" }
# returns account_id
```
Smoke test:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN_xyz" https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/models/list
# expect HTTP 200 + models array
```

Maya (AM): great, I'll consolidate into one handoff doc and share with StrataCo before Fri. Please drop any follow-ups into the PR. Thanks! :raised_hands:
